verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Mistral Large 3 ranked on LMArena, an independent leaderboard, at #28 with an ELO of 1418 versus 1491 for the leader. Separate community discussion compares Magistral's benchmark results against DeepSeek-R1, though it is unclear whether those numbers were independently run. So the model does appear in third-party rankings rather than only vendor-reported numbers. Missing for 10: coverage across several independent leaderboards (only LMArena is concretely cited), first-party pointers to third-party evaluations, and stronger corroboration beyond a single community comment.
